output.content: I was digging through the recent retraining logs for the northern stores and noticed a pattern in the timestamps. The evaluation phase finishes cleanly, but the subsequent move to the registry sits idle for several hours. I checked the pipeline definitions and confirmed there is no automated trigger bridging these two stages. A human operator has to manually request that transition before the model version becomes available for serving. This manual step introduces a variable delay that is not captured in the standard deployment metrics. I am just flagging the current mechanism as I see it in the codebase, without suggesting any changes to the workflow or the tooling setup.
